status_at_freeze: Retrospective revision after v8.1 and peer review; power extension not yet executed. No claim of preregistration predating the panels or v8.1 outcomes.
purpose: Bounded publication revision: exact remainder acceptance, complete implementation specification, active-repair mechanism/distribution reporting, and matched group-level power at alpha 0.05 and 0.005.
controlling_review: User supplied Independent Peer Review v8.1, major revision; methodological and reporting corrections without new annotations.

manuscript.name: Audit_Repair_v8_1_manuscript.pdf
manuscript.source_status: Read current PDF through Library; exact byte hash is not claimed until bytes are materialized.

frozen_baseline.results_policy: Immutable archive. Revised code and derived outputs are stored separately. No historical output is relabeled as a corrected run.

R1_exact_acceptance.represented_grid_guard: If float(grid[j])=a/b exactly, also require N*(2*a-b)-b*sum(d_i)>0.
R1_exact_acceptance.decision: Accept only when the remainder is nonempty and both exact Python-integer numerators are strictly positive. No epsilon substitution.
R1_exact_acceptance.numerical_scope: This correction fixes final remainder decision arithmetic. Floating capital, stake updates, and impossible-null tolerance remain the explicitly documented frozen rules; no general rounding-safety theorem is claimed.

regression.expected: reject exact zero even when floating margin is positive

R1_exact_acceptance.replay: Audit archived factorial prefixes and reconstruct E1/E4 preprocessing trajectories with saved hashes. Compare stopping decisions, audit sets, labels and score hashes; rerun downstream PAC only if corrected preprocessing inputs differ.

R2_implemented_conventions.final_PAC: Terminal rejection at fixed m=500, log K_m >= log(1/alpha_final); no sticky rejection. Preserve the convention that generated v8.1.
R2_implemented_conventions.group_CS: Sticky rejection at any prefix, lower endpoint immediately preceding first never-rejected grid index.
R2_implemented_conventions.stakes: Both stages retain c=0.5 and actual regularized predictable updates; fully specified in accompanying algorithm document.
R2_implemented_conventions.threshold_ties: Tests use U<=u; threshold review uses U>=u_hat; automatically retained labels have U<u_hat. Audited items use U=-1 and expert labels.
R2_implemented_conventions.certified_comparator: Post-warm-up frozen reference, distinct from final same-audit DS comparator.

R3_R4_active_analysis.source: All frozen E2_E3 checkpoints and rows; no additional real-data sampling.
classification: no certified action in any sampled seed
some certified action and all paired costs equal
some certified action and some paired costs unequal
R3_R4_active_analysis.primary_saving: C_same_audit - C_repair, positive means fewer unique expert labels.
denominators: all 20 preprocessing seeds and 200 repetitions per cell
accepted preprocessing states and their repetitions, explicitly descriptive conditional subset
R3_R4_active_analysis.mean_practical_threshold: 0.01*N unique labels; mean saving threshold distinct from per-repetition events
distributions: 20 seed means and per-seed event frequencies
R3_R4_active_analysis.inference: Whole preprocessing-seed clusters. Retain original mean paired intervals as pointwise conditional-panel summaries. Rates and accepted-only distributions are descriptive; no binomial intervals treating PAC repetitions as independent.
R3_R4_active_analysis.degenerate_intervals: Explicitly flag; zero bootstrap width cannot exclude unseen outcomes or demonstrate practical equivalence.
R3_R4_active_analysis.deprecated_flag: Remove ci_rules_out_1pct_saving from v8.2 publication summaries. Preserve archived tables byte-for-byte.

R5_reporting.O1_scope: E1 O1 savings are zero; factorial O1 effects can be nonzero. O1 maximizes no cost objective and is only a restricted accuracy-oriented action oracle.
R5_reporting.transfer_interpretation: Development result did not generalize to frozen holdout; selection optimism and/or pool heterogeneity are plausible, not separately identified.

power_extension.scope: Isolated fixed-group operating characteristic under current stopping/cap rules with full group allowance. It is not end-to-end power of a 10-group shortlist with shared budget.
power_extension.population_construction: Match original safeguard-validity integer composition rule; record actual counts and mean separately from requested mean.
outputs: acceptance rate and exact pointwise binomial 95% intervals
paired alpha-level power difference on same orders
power_extension.no_adaptive_extension: Do not increase replication count or select plotted settings after inspecting outcomes. Negative-gain Type I fixtures remain in prior verification evidence.

release_gates: cell partition and cost accounting reproduce
full source/protocol/output hashes and dependency provenance supplied
provenance_policy: Record exact corrected code and script hashes, full protocol hashes, environment metadata and focused dependency lock. Distinguish independent mathematical/reference checks from same-code second-workstation execution.
